Expression of Concern.note: Publisher term; keep English (lower-case 'expression of concern' in running text: 'Expression of Concern').

FORRT Replication Database.note: Name of the data source; keep English.

Meta Report.note: ORE's summary report for a page.

pill.note: The small labels ORE adds next to papers. Use 'Markierung' consistently.

reference.note: An entry in a paper's reference list; 'references' (section) → 'Literaturverzeichnis'.

Registered Report.note: Publication format; keep English, plural 'Registered Reports'.

snooze.note: Temporarily turn ORE off on a site: 'Snooze on this site' → 'Auf dieser Website pausieren'.
